scheme_name: Grant of Subsidy for Procurement of Vehicle
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the fishermen's community
Applicant must be a member of a Fishermen Cooperative Society and have no overdue with the society/department
Applicant must possess a valid driving license issued by the Transport Authority for driving a moped, auto goods carrier or transport vehicle
Applicant must not have previously availed a loan/subsidy under this scheme for the same purpose
Applicant must not be employed in any Government, Government undertaking or Society on a regular, part‑time or temporary basis
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy on purchase of specified fish‑transport vehicles, with maximum subsidy amounts up to ₹5,00,000 per vehicle.
documents_required: Driving license issued by the Transport Authority
